# Saumitra Vihar Plots Lucknow

> Independent resale plot service for Saumitra Vihar Yojna, Lucknow (a residential plotted scheme of UP Awas Evam Vikas Parishad, off New Jail Road / NH-230). Not the official UPAVP website. Listing updated 22 October 2026.

## Key facts
- Resale plots on offer: 17
- Location: off New Jail Road (NH-230), south-east Lucknow; about 18 km from Hazratganj, 18.5 km from Charbagh station, 17.9 km from Lucknow airport (straight line)
- Sellers: landowners who received developed plots under land pooling
- Prices: shared on enquiry, per plot
- Contact: WhatsApp / call +91 85950 02933
- Page: https://saumitraviharlucknow.in/

## Notes
- New UPAVP scheme registration and allotment happen only on https://upavp.in/
- Before paying for a resale plot, check the allotment letter in the seller's name, the plot number on the layout, payment receipts, dues to the Parishad and the transfer rules.
